name: InterContinental Dhaka
positioning: City hotel in Dhaka's downtown business district, right next to Ramna Park, with a millennium-modern look touched by local culture, a temperature-controlled outdoor infinity pool and an open-air Winter Garden for celebrations
best_for: Business travelers who want a base in Dhaka's downtown business district
Guests who want a pool and spa to unwind after a busy day in the city
Couples and families planning weddings or celebrations

facts.text: The hotel is in the downtown business district of Dhaka, the capital of Bangladesh.
The hotel sits right next to Ramna Park and is near government offices and historic attractions.
The hotel has a millennium-modern look with a touch of local culture.
The outdoor swimming pool is temperature controlled and has infinity views of the lush surroundings.
The Winter Garden is an open-air venue for celebrations, from weddings to corporate exhibitions.
The pillarless Ruposhi Bangla Grand Ballroom has high ceilings, designer chandeliers and a pre-function area overlooking the garden.
The Spa offers signature treatments and therapies, with steam bathing and hydrotherapy.
The Signature Cut is the hotel's unisex salon.
Classic Rooms have a 49-inch LED TV, an ergonomic work area and a rain shower.
Room types include Classic Rooms, Premium Rooms, Junior Suites, One Bedroom Suites and a Presidential Suite.
Aquadeck, the poolside restaurant, has green views of Ramna Park and cozy private booths.
The Amber Room is a steakhouse for grilled steaks and seafood.

highlights.text: The hotel sits right next to Ramna Park, in Dhaka's downtown business district.
The temperature-controlled outdoor pool has infinity views of the lush surroundings.
The open-air Winter Garden hosts celebrations, from weddings to corporate exhibitions.
The hotel pairs a millennium-modern look with a touch of local culture.
Aquadeck, the poolside restaurant, looks out over the green of Ramna Park.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the urban location can bring typical city traffic congestion.
